integration.name: AWS End User Messaging
integration.summary: Native AWS messaging that lands on your existing AWS invoice — the natural choice if your infrastructure already lives in AWS.

credentials.label: Access Key ID
credentials.note: An IAM access key with permission to send SMS.

credentials.label: Secret Access Key
credentials.note: Paired with the access key above.

config.label: AWS region
config.note: Required. Messaging availability and sender identities differ per region.

config.label: Sender IDs
config.note: Numbers, short codes or sender IDs available in that region.

strengths: Billing and IAM stay inside your AWS account
Consistent with the rest of an AWS-based stack
considerations: The region is mandatory — messaging limits and available sender types are region-specific.
Our default pacing starts at 1 message/second. AWS grants sending quotas per account and region, so check your Service Quotas page and raise the pacing to match.
